info.name: File Activity Monitor
info.summary: Search and monitor file activities in Nextcloud
info.description:
File Activity Monitor provides administrators with a search interface to track user actions on files in Nextcloud.
**Requirement:** the Activity app must be enabled. This app searches the records written by Nextcloud's built-in Activity app; without it there is nothing to search and every query returns an error. Activity ships with Nextcloud and is enabled by default.
**Use Cases:** - Troubleshoot broken file synchronization caused by removed shares - Identify who deleted or moved important files or folders - Investigate sync conflicts and permission issues - Track accidental deletions before they impact the team - Audit file access and modifications for compliance
**Features:** - Search activities by user, filename, action type, and date range - User autocomplete for easy selection - Support for multiple activity types (modified, deleted, shared, etc.) - Admin-only access for security
**Security:** This application requires administrator privileges and should only be accessible to trusted administrators as it provides access to all user file activities.
